index: repoke: every package manager, one command

repoke finds the package managers on your machine (Homebrew, npm, pnpm, pip, cargo, apt, winget and more), shows what is outdated and upgrades what you pick, from a terminal, a script, a schedule or an AI agent.
commands: Every repoke command and option: list, check, upgrade, export, init, schedule, self-update, mcp and plugin, with configuration, JSON output and exit codes.
